messages.author: 4edee7e2edd7472b
messages.subject: processBismarkAln results
parts:
Hello,
 
I have a question about the bisulfite conversion rate in the processBismarkAln function.

How is the average conversion rate 198%. Does it mean 98%?

Here is the summary after reading a sorted bam file.

4015433 4018952
total otherC considered (>95%% C+T): 8034385
average conversion rate = 198.05627264982
total otherC considered (Forward) (>95%% C+T): 4015433
average conversion rate (Forward) = 198.0333589807
total otherC considered (Reverse) (>95%% C+T): 4018952
average conversion rate (Reverse) = 198.0791662557
Reading methylation percentage per base for sample: DMSO1

Any suggestions on what it means is highly appreciated.

Thanks,
Neel

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] processBismarkAln results
parts:
this is a bug, i think we fixed it in the latest version. To get the real conversion rate divide it by 2.

Best,
Altuna
